description: Validates that requirements have been properly ingested and structured

checks.remediation: Run requirements-ingest on the source documents

checks.description: requirements.json must identify the project and carry a non-empty requirements list
checks.remediation: Write project_id and the requirements array per the skill's JSON structure

checks.description: Every requirement must have an ID, text, and at least one classification tag
checks.remediation: Give every requirement an id, text, and tags

checks.description: Requirement IDs should follow R-[###] (existing projects that use another prefix, such as TC-, are not blocked)
checks.remediation: Number requirements R-001, R-002, ... in document order (a letter suffix such as R-309a is accepted for a requirement split after IDs were published)

checks.description: requirements.md must contain the requirements table
checks.remediation: Write the report with a '## Requirements' section listing every requirement

checks.description: Requirements should record where in the source they came from
checks.remediation: Add source_file and location_hint so each requirement can be found in its source

checks.description: A plausible number of requirements should be extracted
checks.remediation: Very few requirements suggests an incomplete read of the sources; very many suggests over-splitting or mixed-perspective content (consider requirements-sanitize)
